sources.scope: Bounded municipal urban predios returned around a map point. Area completeness, radius, transfer behavior and municipal extent are unverified. Unidentified objects are excluded; distinct native IDs are preserved even when polygons overlap. Adjacent small cells share bounded 0.004-degree map-point requests for 30 seconds; exact-ID operations independently locate and refetch their native rings. Unusable source rings are reported and omitted without repair; an exact read of an unusable native ID fails. A native ID with conflicting rings is reported as ambiguous and excluded, never resolved by taking the first ring. Requested ambiguous IDs fail exact reads.
